versions.changelog: Add cursor pagination, todo state and due-date updates, custom vocabulary, writable Topic session types, current Session fields, and current webhook contracts.
Add write endpoints: topics CRUD, contexts CRUD, webhooks create/list/delete. Strengthen mutation safety rules with webhook destination warnings and deletion confirmation.
Initial release: read-only access to Hedy sessions, transcripts, highlights, todos, topics, and contexts via the REST API. Supports US and EU region endpoints.
